newsitem.title: USA: Banc One, First Data in credit card pact.
newsitem.headline: Banc One, First Data in credit card pact.

text.p: Banc One Corp said Thursday it and First USA Inc agreed to expand a bank card processing pact with First Data Corp.
The three companies reached an agreement for processing all Visa, MasterCard and private label credit cards issued by both Banc One and First USA, to become effective when First USA joins Banc One.

Banc One and First Data also have agreed to form a joint venture for private label credit card processing. Banc One will contribute the Triumph card processing system to the joint venture, the companies said.
Data processing services will be provided by the joint venture for five million First Data accounts and seven million Banc One accounts.
First Data currently processes about 17 million accounts for First USA and Banc One and intends to convert six million more bank card accounts during the next 12 months.
The companies said the pact aims to expand on the planned $6.6 billion acquisition of First USA by Banc One, announced in January.
First Data provides payment systems, electronic commerce and information management services.
